subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` intentionally reject a changed text-model configuration before writing whenever its runtime catalog/auth resolution cannot validate the reference, rather than preserving the prior deferred runtime failure behavior?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility and operator-experience policy choice, not a defect that a narrow follow-up can resolve mechanically.

options.title: Accept set-time validation
options.body: Confirm the fail-closed behavior as the supported contract and allow merge with the documented `openclaw models list` recovery path.

options.title: Preserve deferred behavior
options.body: Keep the existing write behavior and close or redesign the PR around a non-blocking diagnostic path instead.

recommendation.title: Accept set-time validation
recommendation.body: Confirm the fail-closed behavior as the supported contract and allow merge with the documented `openclaw models list` recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their member review note identifies the unresolved point as maintainer acceptance of the compatibility policy.
